aboutSubheading: Reliable electrical services for your home or business
aboutText: Based in Thornbury, Power Please is your go-to local electrician for residential and industrial work. I provide honest, reliable service to homes and businesses across Melbourne's inner north. From switchboard upgrades and three phase outlets to full renovations, I handle jobs of all sizes with care and expertise. Need a free quote? Just message me your suburb and a brief job description.
servicesHeading: What We Can Do For You
servicesText: Power Please offers a full range of electrical services tailored to Thornbury homes and industrial sites. From simple repairs to complex installations, we deliver safe, efficient work every time.

services.title: Residential Electrical
services.desc: General wiring, lighting, power points, and safety checks for Thornbury homes and secondary dwellings.

services.title: Switchboard Upgrades
services.desc: Modernising outdated switchboards to meet current safety standards and improve your property's electrical capacity.

services.title: Industrial Workshops & Warehouses
services.desc: Complete electrical fit-outs and maintenance for industrial spaces, workshops, and warehouses across the northern suburbs.

services.title: Motors & Controls
services.desc: Expert installation, repair, and maintenance of motors and control systems for industrial and commercial equipment.

services.title: Three Phase Outlets
services.desc: Professional installation of three phase outlets to power heavy machinery and commercial appliances safely.

services.title: Renovations & Secondary Dwellings
services.desc: Specialised electrical services for home renovations and new secondary dwellings, ensuring compliance and quality.
